title: An Act to Allow Testing of Pregnant Persons for Drugs Directly Before and After Childbirth

summary.text: This bill allows a health care provider to administer a blood test before and after childbirth to a pregnant person with the person's consent to determine the presence of drugs or medications and requires a record to be kept of any drug or medication administered to the pregnant person during childbirth. Prior to a report of drug use being made, all blood tests must be reconciled, and all records of drugs and medications administered and the results of the blood tests must accompany the report.
